systems.platform: custom software developed by EPOP Survey Consultoria e Serviços
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, with UNFPA support
systems.tiers: pre-pilot from 2 May 2019 with officers of three police stations in Maputo and Matola, who fill out a registration form and insert its data in the platform; expansion to the whole country intended later

note: InfoViolencia registers and manages gender-based violence cases only: one class of offence, so single-function and no fact for the record class.
